pin.title: Tomoe Sushi — Sapporo Tanukikoji Announces November 21 Opening
pin.description: An announced ten-seat sushi restaurant on the fifth floor of Koshido 3・3 Building, scheduled to open November 21. Its published ¥16,000 Nagi course includes Hokkaido seafood and nigiri; a private room carries a separate ¥2,000 charge per room. Card photo shows the host building, not a completed dining room.
pin.address: 北海道札幌市中央区南3条西3-11-4 恒志堂3・3ビル5F
pin.dateConfidenceReasoning: Exact branch operator-managed Tabelog listing and published course page both state November 21,2026 opening at South 3 West 3-11-4, Koshido 3・3 Building 5 F. Employer announcement independently identifies the same planned new 5 Frestaurant. This is an announced physical branch opening, not the building’s 1990 completion or the opening of Nidaime Tatsuyoshi on other floors. Confirm launch changes before travel.
pin.longFormSummary:
An announced ten-seat sushi restaurant on the fifth floor of Koshido3・3Building, scheduled to open November21. Its published ¥16,000 Nagi course includes Hokkaido seafood and nigiri; a private room carries a separate ¥2,000 charge per room. Card photo shows the host building, not a completed dining room.

Exact branch operator-managed Tabelog listing and published course page both state November21,2026opening at South3West3-11-4, Koshido3・3Building5F. Employer announcement independently identifies the same planned new5Frestaurant. This is an announced physical branch opening, not the building’s1990completion or the opening of Nidaime Tatsuyoshi on other floors. Confirm launch changes before travel.

The published branch gallery is empty. The credited photograph shows the exact host building exterior; photograph date is not published and it does not establish a completed Tomoe interior. Planned menu and hours require launch reconfirmation.
